summary: Frontend-only mobile web testing completed for chat and send-money updates. /send-money rendered correctly with screenshot-style tabs/cards and both transfer + contact picker modals opening. Chat route rendered, but selecting a disappearing-message option throws a runtime error (`writeStoredJson is not defined`).

ui_bugs.issue: Tapping a disappearing option crashes with `Uncaught Error: writeStoredJson is not defined` from app/chat/[conversationId].tsx:973.

integration_issues.issue: Mic button is visible/tappable, but recording controls (cancel + pause/resume + send) did not render in this web preview run; likely blocked by unavailable conversation state and/or microphone permission flow.

react_native_issues.issue: Non-blocking warnings persist (expo-notifications web listener unsupported, expo-av deprecation, style prop deprecation warnings).

action_items: Fix chat disappearing-message persistence by importing/defining `writeStoredJson` in /app/frontend/app/chat/[conversationId].tsx and retest each option tap.
Re-test voice recording controls in an authenticated, accessible conversation with microphone permissions granted to confirm cancel/pause/send row appears as requested.
After chat fix, rerun combined chat regression to ensure no red-screen appears when using the new top disappearing button.
critical_code_review_comments: Root-cause confirmed: `writeStoredJson` is used in /app/frontend/app/chat/[conversationId].tsx but not imported from ../../src/lib/settingsStorage.
/app/frontend/app/chat/[conversationId].tsx is very large (>1700 lines), increasing regression risk and making feature QA harder.
Dead/duplicate message bubble implementation remains in the same file while MediaBubble is used for rendering, which is a DRY maintainability risk.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Send-money redesign is stable in current preview and modals open as expected. Primary blocker is chat disappearing-option runtime crash; voice recording controls still need authenticated + mic-permission validation.
rca_of_issue: Repro: open /chat/testconversation1 -> tap top disappearing button -> tap `24 hours` option. Result: red error overlay. RCA: handler calls `writeStoredJson(...)` at line 973 but the symbol is undefined because it is not imported, causing immediate runtime exception.
